rules.statement: Preserve non-overridable core invariants across every lower authority layer.
rules.rationale: Lower-precedence preferences must never weaken safety or governance guarantees.

rules.statement: Persist and version every material architectural decision in the project repository.
rules.rationale: An AI conversation is context, never an authoritative project record.

rules.statement: Review material code and design changes against the applicable Clean Code, SOLID and foundational principles without treating heuristics as universal hard gates.
rules.rationale: Contextual review improves maintainability while misuse risks and exceptions prevent dogmatic abstractions or mechanical fragmentation.

rules.statement: Produce fresh verification evidence before claiming a change complete or correct.
rules.rationale: Assertions without current evidence are not reliable completion criteria.

rules.statement: Apply quality gates proportionally to L0-L3 impact and never treat a missing required gate as passing.
rules.rationale: Sustainable rigor should rise with risk while deterministic omissions remain visible.

rules.statement: Keep model routing recommendation-only until conformance thresholds and explicit human activation are recorded.
rules.rationale: Cost and capability routing must be proven before it can autonomously select models.

rules.statement: Obtain explicit human approval before destructive, irreversible or production-impacting actions.
rules.rationale: High-impact side effects require accountable human intent.

rules.statement: Stop repeated correction loops, preserve evidence and escalate suspected framework conflicts for human review.
rules.rationale: Repetition without new hypotheses increases damage while producing no information.

rules.statement: Expose credentials, tokens, private keys or other secrets in output, logs or committed artifacts.
rules.rationale: Secret disclosure crosses a non-recoverable security boundary.
